verdict.rationale: Grafana has explicit trace-to-logs/metrics correlation features: Tempo lets you link tracing data with logs and metrics, Prometheus exemplars let you jump from metrics to traces, and the metrics-to-logs 'preserved label filters' switch is highlighted as a signature feature; during incident response docs also describe investigating with the same metrics, logs, and traces that fired an alert. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on account specifically confirming span-to-log jump in Explore, and no mention of trace-to-log correlation (vs. metric-to-trace) working seamlessly in practice.
